input.subject: Roronoa Zoro
input.continuity: One Piece manga through the end of Wano Country arc
input.intent: Produce a faithful playable Straw Hat unit using the current Manga Mayhem contract. Exactly three paths of five concrete cumulative purchases, legal maximum 5-2-0. Every purchase must change executable behavior. Source facts must be established by fresh research. Disclose numerical tuning, unlock schedules and bounded interpretations as game adaptations; distinguish omitted powers from implemented powers. This is a stationary tower encounter with caller-supplied enemy motion and ally injuries, not tower defensive combat or free unit movement. Avoid unsupported air-only target classes, tower HP, shields, taunt, or invented powers. If a source trait has no runtime representation, preserve it in an explicit omission rather than a fake stat bonus. Use the supported schema exactly, including resources, projectile flight, target geometry, statuses, and shared technique lifecycle. Balance is a later measured pass; prices are provisional. World units are shared across the crew: ordinary close contact roughly 8-18, stretched or ranged profiles roughly 30-60; do not treat these as canon measurements. Keep signatures recognizable and source-backed. Three-sword swordsmanship with One/Two-Sword techniques, ranged flying slashes, Armament and Observation, Asura and King of Hell through Wano. Distinguish sword sweep damage, ranged cut techniques, Haki penetration and taxing advanced modes. Model Asura as a bounded technique or brief attack state, not perpetual extra bodies. Do not imply a Devil Fruit. Retain his loyalty and poor direction sense as personality, not invented combat buffs.

context.cutoff: One Piece manga through the end of Wano Country arc
context.coverage: Character-specific capabilities are requirements to verify, not evidence. Record unsupported facts as gaps. No old generated artifacts supplied.

findings.message: Pulse and emission cycles count successful primary attack cycles required for one trigger, not waves per trigger. A cycle counts once when at least one primary hit applies positive damage, regardless of collateral targets. Pulses apply stun without damage; their event amount counts affected targets. Emissions apply their declared damage. Pulse intervals can further limit trigger frequency.

The candidate's claim that all path purchases are concrete cumulative purchases and that every purchase changes executable behavior is a game-contract assertion, not a character-evidence fact.
